processing.notes: Preserve language, source and shard provenance, validate transcripts and speaker boundaries, run privacy and rights screening, and document excluded samples.

datasets.name: Flickr 5B metadata
datasets.description: A very large Flickr metadata collection whose rows provide image URLs at multiple resolutions plus available license, geolocation, date, description, and machine-tag fields; it does not redistribute a canonical media archive.

access.notes: The Hugging Face repository distributes sharded URL metadata; an account or authentication may be required, and each source image can disappear independently.

scale.notes: The current dataset description says approximately 5B Flickr images; earlier snapshots and mirrors reported smaller row counts.

license.media: Rights and Creative Commons terms vary by the original Flickr item
license.notes: ODC-By applies to the metadata database, not automatically to every linked image; users must preserve item-level licenses and verify current source rights.

known_limitations: URL survival, rate limits, and access permissions change over time.
Web descriptions and tags are noisy and are not guaranteed to describe visible content.
The repository-scale count has changed across published snapshots and should be treated as approximate.

processing.recipe: recipes/image_text
processing.notes: Stream metadata shards, retain the original row and item license, fetch only permitted media, record fetch time and result, hash payloads, and deduplicate before use.

datasets.name: MiraData
datasets.description: A long-video metadata collection with 330K, 93K, 42K, and 9K filtered variants, retaining source URLs, clip timing, dimensions, motion and style descriptors, and structured English captions.

access.notes: The official repository distributes metadata and download scripts that retrieve source videos; it does not host a rights-cleared media archive.

scale.notes: The largest released metadata variant has 330K clips, with successively filtered 93K, 42K, and 9K subsets.

license.media: Upstream source-video terms and copyright
license.notes: The Hugging Face license tag covers the release repository and metadata; downloading a URL does not grant training, commercial, or redistribution rights to the underlying video.

known_limitations: URLs can disappear or change, so the published metadata does not guarantee reproducible media availability.
Structured captions are model-generated and may hallucinate objects, camera motion, background, or style.
Rights, consent, safety, duplicate handling, and geographic or demographic coverage remain source-dependent.

processing.recipe: Run the official download_data.py over pinned metadata rows, cut source videos by timestamp, and retain source identifiers and takedown status.
processing.notes: Treat every retrieved video as separately rights-gated and propagate removals requested through the project contact.

datasets.name: OpenVid-1M
datasets.description: A curated collection of one million high-quality video clips with expressive captions, including a large high-definition subset for video generation.

access.notes: Videos, CSV metadata, and split archives are hosted on Hugging Face.

scale.notes: The project reports about 1M clips, including 433K clips at 1080p.

license.media: Source-dependent with research and non-commercial restrictions stated
license.notes: The dataset card asks users to follow licenses of upstream video datasets and states a research and non-commercial intent despite the CC-BY label.

known_limitations: Upstream datasets have different or unknown media terms.
Curated aesthetic distributions may narrow content diversity.

processing.recipe: recipes/video_text
processing.notes: Validate archives, normalize codecs, and preserve upstream dataset provenance.

datasets.name: AutoReCap-XL
datasets.description: A large automatically recaptioned audio-text corpus derived from YouTube video segments, with a 47M-pair released XL set and progressively filtered MQ, MQ-L, and HQ subsets based on CLAP alignment and duration.

access.notes: About 17.4 GB of JSON metadata is hosted on Hugging Face; the official scripts reconstruct audio from referenced source videos rather than distributing raw media.

scale.notes: The released variants contain 47M XL, 20.7M MQ, 14.7M MQ-L, and 10.7M HQ pairs; the original paper describes a 57M-candidate collection before the final release filtering.

license.media: Source-dependent YouTube and rightsholder terms
license.notes: The project limits the release to non-commercial research; raw audio is reconstructed from YouTube and remains subject to source rights and platform terms.

known_limitations: Automatic speech and music keyword removal can suppress useful mixed or ambiguous sound events.
Generated captions and CLAP thresholds can reinforce the teacher model's vocabulary and alignment biases.
Source videos can disappear or change, and the released metadata does not convey media rights.

processing.notes: Preserve source ID, timestamps, original transcript signal, generated caption, CLAP score, subset membership, retrieval date, and rights decision.

datasets.name: ChronoMagic-Pro
datasets.description: A 460K-example time-lapse video-text corpus for learning physical processes and long-range metamorphic motion, with a 150K-example high-quality ProH subset selected for visual quality and caption alignment.

access.notes: Roughly 2.06 TB of videos and metadata are hosted on Hugging Face without a gate.

scale.notes: The official project reports 460K time-lapse videos and a 150K high-quality ChronoMagic-ProH subset.

license.media: CC-BY-4.0 dataset label plus source-video terms
license.notes: The hosted card is tagged CC-BY-4.0, but original video rights and any source-platform conditions should be checked before commercial training or redistribution.

known_limitations: Time-lapse capture and web sourcing bias the corpus toward visible processes and popular subjects.
Automated captioning and quality scoring can miss subtle process direction, duration, or causal details.
The headline corpus and ProH subset should not be combined as independent samples.

processing.recipe: recipes/video_text
processing.notes: Preserve full versus ProH membership, time-lapse category, original duration and frame rate, caption, quality scores, and source identifier.

datasets.name: ViViD
datasets.organization: University of Science and Technology of China and Alibaba Group
datasets.description: A multi-category high-resolution video virtual-try-on dataset pairing product garment images with indoor model videos and derived agnostic, mask, and DensePose conditions for upper-body, lower-body, and dress try-on.

access.notes: The official Hugging Face repository hosts ViViD.zip (about 32.1 GB) and a viewer with 38,800 rows representing four condition groups over 9,700 garment-video pairs.

scale.notes: The paper reports 9,700 pairs, 1,213,694 total frames, 832 by 624 source resolution, and upper-body, lower-body, and dress categories.

license.metadata: Apache-2.0 declared by the Hugging Face card
license.media: Apache-2.0 is declared at repository level, but the underlying Net-A-Porter image and video rights are not enumerated per item
license.notes: The repository license and dataset tag do not replace review of the upstream e-commerce media, depicted people, trademarks, and Net-A-Porter terms.

known_limitations: The corpus focuses on indoor product-presentation videos and the paper reports artifacts on outdoor inputs.
Every source item comes from one named e-commerce website, limiting environment, motion, demographic, and retail-domain diversity.
The public repository has an empty README and does not expose per-item source URLs, consent records, or upstream rights metadata.
Derived masks, parsing, DensePose, and automatic categories inherit failures from OpenPose, SCHP, DensePose, SAM, and BLIP-2.

processing.recipe: Download paired product images and model videos from Net-A-Porter; crop video to 832 by 624; derive 18 body keypoints with OpenPose, human parsing and agnostic regions with SCHP, pose videos with DensePose, garment masks with SAM, and garment categories with BLIP-2.
processing.notes: Keep raw video, garment image, garment mask, agnostic video, agnostic mask, and DensePose video synchronized by pair identifier; retain the publisher's split when using ViViD as an iTryOn stage-one source.

datasets.name: Short-Films-20K
datasets.organization: University of Central Florida and University of Maryland
datasets.description: A metadata release covering 20,143 amateur short films from YouTube and Vimeo, totaling 3,582 hours, with 189,965 natural-language question-answer rows tied to source-film URLs.

access.notes: Hugging Face hosts CSV metadata and source URLs rather than a durable archive of the YouTube and Vimeo media; retrieval and availability must be checked per item.

scale.notes: The official project reports 20,143 films and 3,582 hours; the Hugging Face table contains 189,965 question-answer rows, which are annotations rather than extra films.

license.media: Copyright remains with original YouTube and Vimeo owners
license.notes: The dataset card's noncommercial share-alike license covers the released metadata; source-video rights remain layered and must be reviewed independently.

known_limitations: Source URLs can disappear, change, or become geographically restricted after the metadata snapshot.
Amateur-film and platform selection biases affect genre, production quality, language, and demographic coverage.
Question-answer generation and filtering can retain factual or temporal errors.

processing.recipe: Collect amateur short-film URLs, retain long-form narrative videos, and create question-answer annotations for temporal and narrative understanding.
processing.notes: Preserve the original URL, platform ID, retrieval timestamp, availability result, annotation row ID, and split; do not treat metadata licensing as a media redistribution grant.

datasets.name: Infinity-Instruct
datasets.description: A versioned, multilingual family of millions of selected and evolved instruction-response records with task labels and reward scores for scalable supervised and preference tuning.

access.notes: Multiple versions and configurations are hosted as Parquet; consumers should pin the exact configuration and revision used.

scale.notes: The project targets a 10M family and exposes several 3M, 7M, core, generated, and chat configurations rather than one immutable split.

license.media: Text records subject to component-source and share-alike terms
license.notes: The hosted dataset is marked CC BY-SA 4.0, while downstream users must retain attribution, share-alike obligations, and component provenance.

known_limitations: Version names cover materially different source, selected, evolved, and preference subsets.
Model-generated instructions and reward labels can transmit evaluator and teacher-model bias.

processing.notes: Pin configuration and revision, retain source and reward metadata, and deduplicate against downstream evaluation and preference sets.

datasets.name: StyleBooth Dataset
datasets.organization: Alibaba DAMO Academy and Scepter Studio
datasets.description: A public style-editing corpus of source and target image pairs with text- and exemplar-based multimodal instructions, used by UniGen-AR for 11K de-stylize-and-restyle training examples.

access.notes: The official Scepter Studio repository hosts stylebooth_dataset.zip at about 3.27 GB under revision c993df593ed451c137118b5426a1dcab29e38d5c.

scale.notes: UniGen-AR reports 11K style-transfer examples; the public archive should be inspected for exact row and source-image counts before deriving new totals.

license.media: Apache-2.0 repository label with upstream and generated-image rights requiring review
license.notes: The Hugging Face repository declares Apache-2.0; users should verify whether the archive contains additional image-source or generator-specific conditions.

known_limitations: Style categories and synthetic transformation recipes may favor the generators and templates used during construction.
The public file listing does not expose a per-item rights and provenance ledger.
Source-target pairs and alternate instruction forms can be correlated and require source-aware splitting.

processing.recipe: Construct paired de-stylization and restylization examples with text and exemplar instructions for multimodal style editing.
processing.notes: Pin the release archive, split by underlying source content, and preserve instruction modality and transformation provenance.

datasets.name: MVHumanNet
datasets.description: A large multi-view daily-dressing human capture corpus with identities, outfits, motion sequences, calibrated imagery, parametric bodies, and text descriptions for human rendering, reconstruction, and avatar generation.

access.notes: Users accept the project terms, submit a form, and receive expiring download links for the released parts.

scale.notes: The full project scope is 645M frames, 60K motion sequences, 9K outfits, and 4.5K identities; the repository says the public Part 1 plus Part 2 release covers about 4K identities and 8K outfits.

license.media: Non-commercial research and educational use only
license.notes: The data follows the project-specific Terms of Use; the repository's CC-BY-NC-4.0 license is stated for code and must not be assumed to replace the data agreement.

known_limitations: Full-scale headline counts differ from the currently documented public release coverage.
The capture setup and selected outfits, identities, motions, and camera views may bias downstream avatars toward the collection protocol.
Consent, identity, biometric, and clothing-rights constraints require review before any derived model is deployed.

processing.notes: Preserve outfit, identity, sequence, camera, calibration, body-model, and terms-of-use lineage through every derived view or mesh.

datasets.name: Panda-70M
datasets.description: A large video-caption corpus produced by splitting source videos into semantically consistent clips and captioning them with multiple teachers.

access.notes: CSV metadata and download tooling are provided for source videos.

scale.notes: Statistics refer to the full training split reported by the project.

license.media: Source-dependent
license.notes: The maintainers require users to follow the related license of publicly sourced video samples; availability is primarily metadata plus tooling.

known_limitations: Download success and the resulting corpus vary with source availability.
Machine captions and scores can propagate teacher-model biases.

processing.recipe: recipes/video_text
processing.notes: Retain source video IDs and clip timestamps through download and sharding.

datasets.name: DL3DV-10K
datasets.description: A real-world scene collection of 10,510 high-resolution videos and 51.2M frames across 65 point-of-interest categories, with camera poses and scene attributes for novel-view, 3D, and video-generation research.

access.notes: Full 480p, 960p, 2K, and 4K variants require accepting the DL3DV terms on Hugging Face; the official repository provides a subset-aware download script and eleven free samples.

scale.notes: 10,510 scene videos and 51.2M frames; the benchmark subset contains 140 separate scenes and must not be conflated with the training collection.

license.media: Custom dataset terms with privacy and ethical-use obligations
license.notes: Access acceptance is mandatory; the project warns that sensitive details can remain despite anonymization and handles reported scenes through manual redaction.

known_limitations: Volunteer capture requirements favor slowly changing scenes, wide camera sweeps, limited motion, and mobile or drone recording conventions.
Sensitive details may remain in real-world imagery despite project anonymization and takedown handling.
The benchmark scenes are explicitly outside the 10K training release and should remain isolated during evaluation.

processing.notes: Use the official download.py script, pin the chosen resolution and scene-hash list, preserve camera files, and keep the separate evaluation release out of training.

datasets.name: LAION-COCO-Aesthetic
datasets.organization: Guangyi Li and LAION-derived dataset contributors
datasets.description: A 4.68M-row LAION-COCO subset pairing web-image URLs with multiple synthetic captions, CLIP similarities, aesthetic and watermark scores, dimensions, and content hashes for text-to-image training.

derived_from.contribution: Original web-image URLs and metadata lineage
derived_from.notes: LAION-COCO recaptioning and aesthetic filtering add derived annotations but do not replace upstream media rights.

access.notes: Hugging Face hosts 4.68M parquet rows and image features; users should pin revision e4e44b67a4690d6de2dd4e92f8e00c4483d3176e.

scale.notes: The current viewer reports approximately 4.68M rows; UniGen-AR samples 4.1M of them.

license.media: Original web-item licenses and rights
license.notes: Apache-2.0 covers the dataset release metadata and code, not every URL-linked image; downstream users must resolve copyright, privacy, publicity, and takedown obligations per item.

known_limitations: URLs and hosted representations can disappear or change after the pinned metadata revision.
Synthetic captions, CLIP similarity, aesthetic scores, and watermark estimates inherit model biases and errors.
Aesthetic filtering does not establish safety, consent, copyright, or demographic balance.

processing.recipe: Filter LAION-COCO-derived rows by aesthetic and related metadata, retain multiple generated captions and similarity scores, and package records as parquet.
processing.notes: Preserve URL, hash, scores, and all caption variants; propagate upstream removals and never treat Apache metadata licensing as a blanket media grant.

datasets.name: CommonCatalog
datasets.description: A family of filtered YFCC100M image subsets with item-level Creative Commons provenance and BLIP-2 synthetic captions, released in commercial and non-commercial license partitions for reproducible text-to-image training.

derived_from.contribution: Flickr identifiers, source metadata, and Creative Commons licensed media pool
derived_from.notes: CommonCatalog re-resolves YFCC100M images, excludes non-derivative licenses, filters the media, and adds BLIP-2 captions.

access.notes: Six Hugging Face repositories partition the corpus by CC-BY, SA, NC, and combined license variants.

scale.notes: The paper reports 67,015,331 images in CommonCatalog-NC, including a 26,232,417-image commercial-use subset; hosted per-license shard counts sum to the same family-level scope.

license.notes: Only the C subset is designed for commercial use; every use must preserve attribution and follow the exact item's Creative Commons variant.

known_limitations: BLIP-2 captions are synthetic, mostly English, and can omit identity, context, or culturally specific details.
The source is decade-old Flickr data with geographic, demographic, and photographic-style skews.
Corpus-level labels do not remove the need for item-level attribution, privacy, and takedown handling.

processing.recipe: recipes/image_text
processing.notes: Keep license partitions separate, retain attribution fields, and never mix the NC shards into a commercial training run.

datasets.name: Open X-Embodiment
datasets.organization: Open X-Embodiment Collaboration and Google DeepMind
datasets.description: A unified RLDS collection of public robot-manipulation datasets spanning multiple institutions and embodiments, with RGB observations, language task instructions, actions, and episode structure.

scale.notes: The paper reports more than one million real-robot episodes across 22 embodiments; the release is a federation of datasets rather than one homogeneous capture protocol.

license.media: Contributing-dataset terms remain applicable
license.notes: The umbrella repository assigns Apache-2.0 to software and CC-BY-4.0 to other materials, while explicitly requiring citation and review of individual contributed datasets.

Aggregate episode counts do not imply balanced sampling across robots, skills, institutions, or environments.
Some source builders require manual cloud download and may not be registered in a local TensorFlow Datasets installation.

processing.notes: Do not collapse the selected ShadowDancer subsets into one license assumption; preserve BridgeData, FurnitureBench, Berkeley UR5, Jaco Play, Stanford HYDRA, and RoboTurk provenance separately.

datasets.name: Pick-a-Pic v2
datasets.organization: Tel Aviv University and Meta AI
datasets.description: An open collection of real user choices between pairs of text-to-image model outputs, with prompts and preference labels for alignment research.

access.notes: The canonical Hugging Face repository currently requires authenticated access.

license.notes: Confirm the current dataset card and the terms of image-generating models; a dataset license may not resolve every right in generated outputs.

datasets.name: FreeMan
datasets.description: A real-world multi-view human-motion dataset captured with eight synchronized smartphones, pairing RGB video with cameras, 2D and 3D keypoints, SMPL parameters, and bounding boxes for human sensing and digital-human research.

Real-world capture improves scene diversity but introduces occlusion, lighting, calibration, and pose-estimation noise.
Human biometric and motion data require privacy review even when the original collection used consent and anonymization procedures.

processing.notes: Keep sequence, subject, camera, calibration, consent, and usage-agreement metadata attached to every derived artifact.

datasets.name: InternVid
datasets.description: A web-scale video-text corpus built from millions of source videos and segmented into captioned clips for multimodal understanding and generation.

access.notes: Public releases include metadata and filtered subsets such as InternVid-10M-FLT.

license.notes: The Apache-2.0 repository license covers code, not necessarily third-party web videos. Review the dataset card and each intended media use.

Web video availability, safety, and rights can change over time.

license.notes: Dataset metadata is ODC-By-1.0, while each object retains its source license; the Polycam contribution is explicitly non-commercial and separately gated.

datasets.name: JourneyDB

datasets.description: A dataset of high-resolution Midjourney-generated images paired with prompts, captions, and visual question answering annotations.

license.notes: Images originate from Midjourney generations and user prompts; review the current dataset agreement and platform terms for the intended use.

datasets.name: CelebV-Text

datasets.name: OmniObject3D

license.notes: Attribution is required; users must still review any rights or restrictions attached to depicted physical objects and downstream transformations.

datasets.name: COYO-700M

datasets.name: CelebV-HQ
datasets.description: A large-scale high-quality face-video collection with diverse identities, head poses, actions, and emotions, distributed as YouTube reconstruction metadata with 83 manually defined facial attributes.

datasets.name: V2C-Animation

license.metadata: No explicit dataset license found in the official repository

Reconstructing the corpus requires lawful access to copyrighted source movies.

datasets.name: Chem
datasets.description: A sentence-level single-speaker chemistry-lecture dubbing corpus built from public YouTube recordings, used to train and evaluate script-conditioned speech generation aligned to an instructor's lip motion.

license.notes: The official project does not publish a dataset license or full corpus package; example-video access does not authorize redistribution of the training corpus.

The complete corpus is not distributed from the official project page.
Copyright and persistence depend on the original YouTube lecture sources.

processing.notes: Use the paper-reported split only when the original corpus has been lawfully obtained; do not reconstruct from unverified mirrors.

datasets.name: CO3D
datasets.description: A real-world collection of object-centric multi-view videos covering common object categories, with camera poses, foreground masks, depth estimates, and reconstructed point clouds for 3D-aware learning and view synthesis.

access.notes: The official v1 repository provides download manifests and tooling for the original CO3D release; the repository's default branch now documents the larger CO3Dv2 separately.

license.notes: Reuse and redistribution require attribution and must remain non-commercial; privacy, depicted-property, and downstream derivative rights still require review.

known_limitations: Crowd-captured sequences vary in lighting, blur, framing, occlusion, and reconstruction quality.
The object-category distribution is limited to common categories and is not representative of all products or environments.
CO3D and CO3Dv2 differ in sequence count, frame quality, masks, and packaging and should not be mixed without version tracking.

processing.recipe: Download the official category archives, preserve sequence and frame identifiers, and keep RGB, masks, depth, camera, and point-cloud annotations aligned.

datasets.name: Clotho 2.1

Omni2Sound names Clotho without identifying which release was used.

datasets.name: VideoMatte240K
datasets.description: A high-resolution green-screen video matting dataset with 240,709 foreground and alpha-matte frames extracted from 484 stock or royalty-free human clips, including 384 4K clips and 100 HD clips.

access.notes: The official project provides downloadable dataset archives; Robust Video Matting also documents 6 GB SD and 60 GB HD preprocessed variants.

The validation split contains only five source clips.

datasets.name: HDTF
datasets.organization: University of Science and Technology of China and Microsoft Research Asia

license.metadata: CC-BY-4.0 stated by the official repository

datasets.name: Conceptual 12M
datasets.description: A twelve-million-scale web image and text metadata collection built by relaxing the Conceptual Captions filtering pipeline to improve long-tail visual and language coverage.

access.notes: The official Google Research Hugging Face repository distributes URL-caption metadata; image availability is source-dependent.

scale.notes: The paper describes 12M image-text pairs.

license.media: Source-dependent
license.notes: URL-caption metadata does not grant blanket rights to the referenced web images; verify source availability, licenses, and platform terms.

datasets.name: ACAV100M
datasets.description: A 100M-clip audio-visual corpus automatically curated from 140M long-form videos by selecting 10-second segments that maximize estimated mutual information between audio and visual embeddings.

access.notes: The official project releases CSV files with YouTube video IDs and start times for 20K, 200K, 2M, 10M, and 100M subsets rather than redistributing media.

license.metadata: No standardized dataset license declared on the project page
license.media: Source-dependent YouTube and rightsholder terms
license.notes: Released CSVs identify source clips but do not grant rights to download, train on, or redistribute the underlying YouTube media.

known_limitations: YouTube videos can be removed, region-blocked, or altered, reducing reproducibility over time.
Mutual-information sampling favors coincident audio and visual events and may underrepresent off-screen sound or abstract audiovisual relationships.
The multilingual, safety, copyright, privacy, and demographic distributions are not exhaustively documented.

processing.notes: Keep YouTube ID, start second, subset size, retrieval date, availability result, and a source-rights decision; never treat the CSV as a media license.

datasets.name: Objectron
datasets.description: A collection of short object-centric videos with camera motion, AR session metadata, sparse point clouds, planes, and manually annotated oriented 3D bounding boxes for multi-view object understanding.

Camera, point-cloud, plane, and 3D-box accuracy vary across sessions.
The license is computational-use specific and does not itself resolve all underlying rights.

Commercial reuse requires filtering or separately clearing clips with restrictive licenses.

datasets.name: Condensed Movies Dataset
